configure.title: Huina
configure.description: Huina koho hiki iā ʻoe ke hōʻike. Ma ka hōʻike ʻana i kahi waiwai huina, pono ka huina o nā waiwai ma ka pūʻulu e like me kēia huina e kaha ai i kahi pai piha. Hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻohana i kēia ʻāpana e kaha ai i nā ʻāpana o ka pai a i ʻole nā pakuhi ana wale nō.

configure.title: Haʻalele i nā waiwai hakahaka
configure.description: E haʻalele ʻia nā waiwai hakahaka e pale ai i ke kaha ʻana i nā ʻāpana a me nā lepili pono ʻole.

advanced.title: Hoʻohuli i ka ʻikepili
advanced.description: Hoʻohuli i ka ʻikepili me nā lepili, ke kaʻina o nā pūʻulu a me nā papa ʻikepili pūʻulu holoʻokoʻa.

advanced.title: Kuʻi paʻa

advanced.title: Kuhikuhina lepili
advanced.description: Kaha i nā ʻāpana kuʻi ma ke ʻano kinona ma kahi o nā kaha.

advanced.title: Kaʻawale lepili
advanced.description: Kaʻawale kūlana lepili mai ke kūlana maʻamau, ʻo ia ka hapalua o ke kaʻawale o ka radius. Hiki i kēia waiwai ke lilo i ka ʻaoʻao maikaʻi a i ʻole ka ʻaoʻao ʻino. E kau nā waiwai maikaʻi i ka lepili i kahi mamao mai ke kikowaena.
